errors.description: flash_word_q is a multi-bit value produced in qspi_clk and sampled directly in ahb_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
burst_done_pulse_q is a one-cycle qspi_clk pulse consumed directly in ahb_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
burst_done_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample ahb_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in ahb_event_o.
read_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector read_mode_q before decoding in ahb_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
qspi_rst_n is used as data inside ahb_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
cfg_snapshot_q combines qspi_clk payload state with ahb_clk status state in cfg_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
